text:
Maya K.: Heads-up — prepping a small example for on-prem VPC install that shows minimal allowed ports + KMS proxy snippet. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
Ashley: Thanks. Can we include both HSM and software KMS examples? Some customers want PKCS#11 + softkms.
Sandeep: FYI, storage team's done a cert rotation step — add step to restart controller after importing certs, otherwise kv cache fails.
Chris: Also add a note about proxy env var for the KMS SDK sample: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY + curl example.
Maya K.: Drafted SDK snippet (Python) — sanity check? ```python
from redwood_kms import Client
c = Client(url='https://kms.local', proxy='http://proxy:3128')
print(c.encrypt(b'mykey'))
```
Ashley: Looks good — change Client to KMSClient and use bytes -> .decode after encrypt? Also include snippet showing PKCS11 envs: ```bash
export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/pkcs11.so
export PKCS11_TOKEN=redwood
```
Sandeep: For air-gapped flows, add steps for offline image import: tarball -> transfer -> `./install --offline --images=/tmp/images.tar.gz` and mention checksum verify.
Maya K.: Good point. Also want link fix — current 'network guide' link points to old internal doc. I'll update to /docs/private/vpc/networking.md
Chris: Small nit: in the install steps we should mention iptables vs nftables on Ubuntu 22.04. Add one-liner to disable nftables or adjust rule order.
docs-bot: PR #421 opened by @maya — checks: linter failed (link-checker). See https://ci.internal/421
Maya K.: On it — fixing broken link to 'HSM quickstart'. Will push patch in ~30m.
Ashley: If you want, I can add a tiny migration table mapping old config keys to new ones.
Maya K.: Please do. Also need a small troubleshooting table for common KMS errors (401, TLS hostname mismatch, PKCS11 driver not found).
Chris: LGTM once link-check passes. :thumbsup:
Maya K.: Updated and pushed. @docs-bot can you re-run link-check please?
docs-bot: Re-run triggered by @maya on PR #421 — link-check passed. CI green.
infra-bot: Deployed preview site for PR #421 at https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr-421 — please sanity-check images and code blocks.
Maya K.: Verified preview; screenshots rendered. Merging after one more approval.
Ashley: Approved. Merge when ready.
Maya K.: Merged — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short changelog entry for release notes.
